traits.name: Attack
traits.description: Bonus to the attack of every unit in the army.

traits.name: Defense
traits.description: Bonus to the defense of every unit in the army.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.description: Bonus to the max HP of every unit, flat and percentage.

traits.name: Morale
traits.description: Extra or lost actions and similar effects.

traits.name: Luck
traits.description: Chance of bonus damage or avoiding a bad outcome.

traits.name: Attack Range
traits.description: Bonus range in hexes for ranged units.

traits.name: Battle Speed
traits.description: Small tiered bonus to unit speed in battle.

traits.name: Magic
traits.description: Magic skill level; spells require a minimum level.

traits.name: Spell Points
traits.description: Size of the spell point pool. Grows automatically on level-up.

traits.name: Spell Recovery
traits.description: Spell points regained per day on the adventure map.

traits.name: Scouting Radius
traits.description: Vision radius on the adventure map.

traits.name: Scouting
traits.description: Sees farther, moves a little faster and can pass closer by monsters and enemy heroes without being attacked (zone of control).
